name: CRAN_get_package
description: Get metadata for a CRAN R package from the CRAN database (crandb). Returns package title, version, description, authors, license, dependencies (Imports, Suggests, Depends), URL, publication date, and release history. CRAN hosts 20,000+ R packages for statistical computing, bioinformatics, data visualization, and machine learning. Use for discovering R package information, checking versions, and finding dependencies.

BugReports.description: Where to report problems, e.g. 'https://github.com/tidyverse/ggplot2/issues'. The maintainer email is for the maintainer; this is the issue tracker.

Collate.description: The order the package's R files are sourced in, as a newline-and-quote-delimited string. Matters only when reconstructing the package, and it is long.

Config/Needs/website.description: Packages needed only to build the package's website, e.g. 'ggtext, tidyr, forcats'. NOTE the '/' characters in the property name.

Config/testthat/edition.description: Which testthat edition the tests are written for, e.g. '3'. A string.

Config/usethis/last-upkeep.description: When the maintainer last ran usethis upkeep, e.g. '2025-04-23'. A rough signal of maintenance, distinct from the release date.

Encoding.description: Character encoding of the package's files, e.g. 'UTF-8'.

Enhances.description: Packages this one extends without depending on, e.g. {'sp': ...}. Optional integrations that are silently inactive if the other package is absent.

LazyData.description: 'true' when datasets load on demand. A string, not a boolean.

MD5sum.description: MD5 of the source tarball, e.g. 'c50d6864f6226ed9759e5deaa0a25e7f'. What verifies a download; the version string does not.

NeedsCompilation.description: 'yes' when the package has compiled code, 'no' when it is pure R. Decides whether installing needs a toolchain.

Packaged.description: When and by whom the tarball was built, e.g. '2026-04-21 12:47:29 UTC; thomas'. One string carrying both, so it must be split to use either.

RoxygenNote.description: Which roxygen2 version generated the documentation, e.g. '7.3.3'.

VignetteBuilder.description: What is needed to build the vignettes, e.g. 'quarto'. An unusual builder is itself an install requirement.

name: CRAN_get_package_versions
description: Get all historical versions of an R package from CRAN with release dates and dependencies for each version. Useful for understanding package evolution, checking compatibility, and finding when specific features were added. Returns the full version timeline with release dates.

versions.description: Map of version string to version metadata (title, description, imports, etc.)

timeline.description: Map of version string to release date (ISO 8601)

_id.description: The package name, which CRAN's CouchDB uses as the document id, e.g. 'ggplot2'.

_rev.description: CouchDB revision token for the record, e.g. '34-94ca0daa28f51a3e74e5aab77836513c'. The leading number counts how many times CRAN's metadata for the package has changed.

archived.description: True when the package has been removed from CRAN. An archived package still has versions and a title, so nothing else in the reply reveals that it can no longer be installed.

latest.description: The current version on CRAN, e.g. '4.0.3'. Which of the listed versions is the one `install.packages` would fetch.

revdeps.description: How many CRAN packages depend on this one, e.g. 410. The measure of how much would break if it changed.

title.description: The package's one-line title, e.g. 'Create Elegant Data Visualisations Using the Grammar of Graphics'.
